headline: As of 2026-10-14: 4,740,589 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 35 of 50 states, D+23.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 4,740,589 early/mail ballots cast so far across 35 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+23.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (631,005), Virginia (568,467), Michigan (520,417).
